objectives: To provide an overview of the American legal system.
content:
See my course website (https://mlwang.wordpress.com/) for the most current syllabus. The following is a tentative list of themes to be covered by the course:
The Background of American Law
The Courts
Statutes and Statute Makers
The Executive Branch
Federalism
Elections and Political Parties
Constitutional Law and Civil Liberties
The Fourth Estate
Crimes and Punishments
Legal Culture
Legal Education & Legal Profession
Law and Social Change
Legal Scholarship
books:
Lawrence M. Friedman & Grant M. Hayden, American Law: An Introduction (3d ed. 2016).
Lawrence M. Friedman, A History of American Law (4th ed. 2019).
William Burnham & Stephen Reed, Introduction to the Law and Legal System of the United States (7th ed., 2021).
